record.name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
record.one_liner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud offers ecommerce solutions for B2B, D2C, and B2C to build personalized, scalable, and high-volume shopping experiences.
record.access_note: Credentials and enterprise access are obtained through Salesforce enterprise contracts, sales partnerships, or specialized commerce accounts.
record.api_note: The B2C Commerce API (SCAPI), Open Commerce API (OCAPI), and Script APIs provide broad read and write coverage for products, baskets, orders, and administrative tasks.
record.blocker_note: Commerce Cloud requires enterprise commercial agreements or partner channels to provision full production environments and administrative credentials.
